en: The image is an illustrated postcard showing a scenic landscape with ancient stone ruins, a prominent arched entry, and what appears to be part of a collapsed wall or tower. Behind the ruins, there is a river and further back, a town featuring a distinct church or cathedral tower with a spire, surrounded by lush greenery and picturesque clouds. The lower right corner of the image has an artist's signature.
